trigger_condition: Sentence 'This creates maintenance burden, obscures the dependency graph, prevents FactoryKit scope optimization, and complicates test assembly configuration' uses 4 different verbs for 4 effects - inconsistent parallelism
guard_snippet: Use parallel structure: 'This creates maintenance burden, obscures the dependency graph, prevents FactoryKit scope optimization, and complicates test assembly configuration' -> 'This burdens maintenance, obscures the dependency graph, prevents FactoryKit scope optimization, and complicates test assembly'
potential_consequence: Minor readability issue; inconsistent phrasing reduces professional polish

trigger_condition: Sentence 'Remove DataSourcesAssembly.swift, RepositoriesAssembly.swift, and AppInfrastructure.swift' uses .swift extension for some files but not others inconsistently
guard_snippet: Either all with .swift or all without: 'Remove DataSourcesAssembly, RepositoriesAssembly, and AppInfrastructure'
potential_consequence: Inconsistent file naming convention in spec

trigger_condition: Bullet points mix present tense ('Dependencies assembled manually') with imperative ('Preserve Step-Driven Coordinator flow') and descriptive ('FactoryKit already integrated')
guard_snippet: Standardize to imperative mood for all constraints: 'Assemble dependencies manually...', 'Preserve Step-Driven Coordinator flow...', 'Use Factory scopes intentionally...'
potential_consequence: Mixed voice makes constraints harder to parse as requirements

trigger_condition: First bullet 'Migrate to a different DI framework (FactoryKit stays)' uses parenthetical for rationale; others don't
guard_snippet: Either add rationale to all or remove from first: 'Do not migrate to a different DI framework; FactoryKit remains the standard'

trigger_condition: Sentence 'Only SessionController and all repositories promoted to .singleton() per decision' is ambiguous - does 'per decision' refer to this decision or a prior one?
guard_snippet: Clarify: 'Only SessionController and all repositories are promoted to .singleton() by this decision' or 'per the planning decision recorded above'
potential_consequence: Ambiguous reference; unclear if this is the decision or referencing another

trigger_condition: Phrase 'Update UseCases.unavailable and test stubs accordingly' is vague - 'accordingly' doesn't specify how
guard_snippet: Be specific: 'Update UseCases.unavailable to use concrete unavailable implementations or remove unavailable variants entirely'
potential_consequence: Implementer guesses at correct approach; inconsistent updates

trigger_condition: Task description is 67 words with multiple clauses; hard to parse as single actionable item
guard_snippet: Split into sub-tasks: 1) Add .singleton() to sessionController and all 5 repositories. 2) Add .cached() to APIClient and other DataSources. 3) Remove dataSourcesAssembly and repositoriesAssembly registrations. 4) Verify all registrations have explicit scope.
potential_consequence: Task too large; hard to track completion; easy to miss sub-items

trigger_condition: Parenthetical '(and tokenStore if not singleton)' creates uncertainty - is tokenStore singleton or not?
guard_snippet: Decide and state clearly: 'and tokenStore (singleton, no override needed)' or 'and tokenStore (override for test keychain service)'
potential_consequence: Implementer must guess; may omit needed override or add unnecessary one

trigger_condition: Long sentence with multiple conditions: 'Given Debug build, when launching app, then SessionController and all repositories... are singleton..., APIClient is cached..., and no manual assembly structs exist' - three different verification targets in one AC
guard_snippet: Split into three ACs: AC2a (singleton verification), AC2b (APIClient cached), AC2c (assembly structs removed)
potential_consequence: Single AC passes if any one condition met; partial failure masked

trigger_condition: Sentence 'Current Container+Registrations already has most registrations but wraps them in manual assemblies' uses 'wraps' metaphorically - technically it references assemblies, doesn't wrap them
guard_snippet: Use precise language: 'Current Container+Registrations already has most registrations but delegates to manual assemblies for construction'

trigger_condition: Statement 'Container+Registrations.swift (167 lines) shows no cycles' presents line count as evidence of no cycles - non sequitur
guard_snippet: Remove line count or make it relevant: 'Manual review of Container+Registrations.swift confirms no cycles' or add tool verification reference
potential_consequence: False confidence; line count doesn't prove acyclic graph

trigger_condition: Phrase 'for consistency and to avoid redundant allocations' - singleton actually increases allocations (one per process) vs cached (one per scope), so rationale is technically inverted
guard_snippet: Correct rationale: 'for consistency and to ensure single shared instance across the app' or 'to avoid redundant allocations within a scope'
potential_consequence: Technically incorrect justification may mislead future maintainers

trigger_condition: Bullet 'Verify no imports of deleted files remain anywhere in codebase' uses 'anywhere in codebase' but project is monorepo with backend/ and apps/ios/ - ambiguous scope
guard_snippet: Specify scope: 'Verify no imports of deleted files remain in apps/ios/ (iOS target)'
potential_consequence: Wasted effort searching backend/ or false confidence if backend references exist
